productConcept.name: Solubl
productConcept.description: Copenhagen cold-process soluble concentrates for bath and skin — 18 SKUs across four collections, each tablet designed to dissolve precisely in water.
productConcept.rationale: The bloom-drift Liquid/Fluid UI concept — borderless organic forms, gradient bleeds, water-surface tension metaphors, and liquidMorph animations — maps precisely to a product whose entire value proposition is dissolution in water. The brand name 'Solubl' and Copenhagen setting reinforce the Scandinavian restraint of the DM Sans type system alongside the warm organic palette.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion.json contained liquidMorph (10.8s), waveFloat (8.1s), fluidEntrance (1.08s), and named easing curves including fluidEase cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94). ScrollTrigger references present in concept_by_video.md.
